title: 2014 AMC 12A Problem 2
statement: At the theater children get in for half price. The price for \(5\) adult tickets and \(4\) child tickets is \(\$24.50.\) How much would \(8\) adult tickets and \(6\) child tickets cost?

solutions.text:
Since a child ticket is half an adult ticket, \(5\) adult and \(4\) child tickets equal \(5+\tfrac12\cdot4=7\) adult tickets, so one adult ticket costs \(\dfrac{24.50}{7}=\$3.50.\)

The second purchase equals \(8+\tfrac12\cdot6=11\) adult tickets, costing \(11\cdot 3.50=\$38.50.\)

Thus, the correct answer is B.
hints: A child ticket costs half an adult ticket, so measure everything in adult tickets
